extracted.name: Gluten-Free Bread in a Bread Machine
extracted.description: This gluten-free bread machine recipe is basic yet reliable, made with gluten-free all-purpose flour. It is perfect for sandwiches, toast, and more.
instruction_lines: Place water, eggs, oil, vinegar, flour, xanthan gum, salt, sugar, and yeast, in that order, in a bread machine.
Run Basic cycle and select Light or Medium for the crust.
Remove when cycle ends. Cool completely before slicing.
